transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this certification meeting. Before I sign off on the administration plan for tomorrow's morning testing session, I need to hear from each of you about any operational requirements or concerns. We have twenty-seven students taking the online state assessment, and the current draft plan has them in the library using student-owned laptops with two proctors, following the standard health-monitoring procedure. I'd like to go around the table -- could each of you share anything I need to know before I certify this plan?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue before we proceed. The state testing office confirmed in a technology support ticket this week that this assessment must run on certified district-managed Chromebooks. Student-owned laptops are not permitted, and a session using them will not be certified. I have not yet copied this confirmation into the assessment certification form, but we cannot move forward with the current plan as drafted.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to raise a facilities concern. The fire-safety inspection record for the library, which I reviewed this week, limits the library to 18 students during a testing session because two exits must remain clear. With 27 students scheduled, we cannot safely or legally use only the library. The certified plan must use both the library and Room 204 to accommodate all 27 students. I have not yet updated the room plan to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to raise a health-related requirement. One of the students scheduled for this testing session has a current health plan that requires a glucose check at 10:00 a.m. during the session. This check must be supervised by me, the nurse, in a room adjacent to the testing room, and the student returns to testing afterward. I confirmed the timing with the family this week, but I have not yet added this accommodation to the testing plan. We'll need an adjacent room available for this, and the proctors should be aware that this student will briefly step out at 10:00 a.m.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to raise a staffing requirement. The state administration manual requires one trained proctor for every 10 or fewer students in an active testing room. For 27 students, the certified plan must assign exactly three trained proctors. I verified this in the current manual but have not yet entered the staffing count in the draft. The current plan only assigns two proctors, so it needs to be updated to three before certification.
